raw_text: Press Release — Ministry of Home Affairs: The Government strongly condemns the cowardly Maoist attack on CRPF personnel in Latehar, Jharkhand. Four brave jawans of 209 Battalion CRPF made the supreme sacrifice in the line of duty. The Home Minister has spoken with the Jharkhand Chief Minister and directed immediate reinforcement of anti-Naxal operations in the Burha Pahar corridor. A high-level security review meeting has been convened. The Government reiterates its commitment to eliminating Left Wing Extremism and bringing peace to affected areas.
